Hong Kong Police Arrest Three in Drug Bust

Hong Kong police arrested three individuals in Fanling and seized HK$23 million worth of "Ice," a form of methamphetamine. The bust was part of an operation that also saw customs officials at the airport seize 13kg of suspected ketamine and arrest one man.
